source.title: National Insurance Institute, תכנית חיסכון לכל ילד (programme page): opened "בקופת גמל או בבנק לפי בחירתכם"

regulator.notes: The National Insurance Institute runs the programme and the Ministry of Finance (Accountant General) picks the banks by tender; the money is a bank deposit at one of the nine participating banks, each a banking corporation under the Supervisor of Banks (Bank of Israel). NII's page names no supervising regulator for the bank option (REG-23); Yahav's agreement refers to bank-supervision directives (institution).

labels: secondary source: 25% of the real gain on a CPI-linked track, 15% of the nominal gain on an unlinked or prime track, withheld by the bank (TXK-23; the official texts give no rate for child savings, TXK OQ1; method G-17)

source.title: National Insurance Institute, child savings: withdrawal page (from 18 with a parent's signature, from 21 alone); law 74ג(ב)

age.notes: Redemption age: the child may withdraw from 18 (from the end of the month of the 18th birthday), with a parent's signature until 21 and alone from 21 (CS-14). Any withdrawal before 21 forfeits the NIS 582 (2026) age-21 grant (CS-13).

lawful_exit.text: from 18 with a parent's signature, from 21 alone; a withdrawal before 21 forfeits the age-21 grant; before 18 only for the child's medical needs with an NII-appointed doctor's approval (CS-15); the bank track is fixed until 18 unless an exit-station type was chosen, which allows a track change every 5 years (CS-10, CS-12); money not withdrawn at 18 renews at the bank for further saving periods, and breaking such a period early can lose interest and linkage (CS-16)

source.title: National Insurance Institute, child savings: change of saving body or track page (bank track only at an exit station; one-time move of future deposits to a provident fund)

switch_is_tax_event.notes: Unknown: no source read states the tax treatment of a track change at a bank exit station, or of redirecting future deposits to a provident fund (TXK OQ1). The product side: the bank track can change only at an exit station, every 5 years, and only if that type was chosen; the plan can never move to another bank; since January 2025 future deposits may be redirected once to a provident fund while the balance stays at the bank (CS-12).

transfer_routes.condition: future deposits only, once, since January 2025; the balance already saved stays at the bank

eligibility.text: every child for whom child allowance is paid, from birth to 18; the parent who receives the allowance must actively choose one of the nine participating banks and a track (fixed unlinked, variable prime-based, or fixed CPI-linked, each with or without an exit station every 5 years) within six months of birth, because the default is a provident fund, not a bank; the parent may turn on the addition from the child allowance at any time; no other money can be deposited

protection.text: the money belongs to the child, is held in trust by the parent and cannot be transferred, pledged or attached; the bank promises that the balance will not fall below the sums NII deposited, in nominal terms, and the interest is known in advance; the money is a bank deposit with no deposit insurance in Israel: if a bank fails the Governor may, with Government approval, announce a guarantee, but is not obliged to
